'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Brian Hunter LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Sealed, Stamped, and MAILED-IN
* '''Username:''' Hunter
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
